summary: Brightline Software Private Limited provides software services to Kaveri Textiles for twelve months from the date both parties sign. The services and user seats are set out in a Statement of Work and an Order Form, and the acceptable use policy is at a web address. Schedule B sets the service levels: the services are available for 95 percent of each calendar month, the only remedy for a miss is a credit of two percent of that month's fee, and the Supplier can suspend the services for maintenance without notice. The Customer pays the fees in Schedule A within thirty days of each invoice.

riskFlags.title: Maintenance suspension without notice
riskFlags.says: The Supplier can suspend the services for maintenance at any time without notice.
sourceSentences: 3. The Supplier can suspend the services for maintenance at any time without notice.
riskFlags.counterOffer: The Supplier can suspend the services for maintenance only after giving the Customer written notice.
